h4: Plan Ahead – Book a Table at Sofra Restaurant
p: Delight in flavors crafted to bring joy, comfort, and unforgettable dining experiences every time.

At Sofra Restaurant, dining is more than just a meal—it’s an experience of flavor, tradition, and hospitality. Inspired by the rich heritage of culinary artistry, Sofra brings together authentic recipes, fresh ingredients, and modern presentation to create dishes that delight every sense.
Seasonal Delights to Enjoy Fresh flavors
An indulgent collection of Italian pastas and Asian noodles with rich sauces.
Indulge in irresistible cakes, pastries, & traditional sweets to end on a high.
Exclusive dishes prepared with passion & creativity, available for a limited time.
Tender salmon fillet, flame-grilled and brushed with garlic butter, served with sautéed greens.
Layers of chia pudding, fresh mango, toasted coconut flakes, and a drizzle of honey.
Al dente pasta tossed with basil pesto, cherry tomatoes, and parmesan shavings.
Golden roasted chicken with crispy skin, served over prosciutto salad and red wine glaze.
